items.text: Chainalysis confirmed its breach to BleepingComputer and told customers to beware of scammers posing as Chainalysis, especially offers of fund recovery or recruiting. It still hasn't said how the attackers got in or how long they stayed.

Toronto police say impersonation scams, callers posing as banks, phone carriers and government offices, are their top fraud this year, with more than $50 million lost by mid-October. They say AI helps the callers sound convincing.
An ad for Florida congressional candidate Sydney Gruters shows rival Kelly Kirschner in an AI-made perp walk. He has never been arrested and says the AI label was shrunk so viewers would miss it.
